content: Reproducible Python API-to-SQLite pipelines separate ingestion (fetch + light validation), storage (append-only writes to SQLite with a manifest/checksum recording query params, row count, download date), and processing (cleaning/transform reading from SQLite into pandas). Reproducibility requires: pin dependency versions, version data provenance (manifest per fetch), keep raw data immutable, and log which data snapshot fed which model run. Workflow tools (Airflow/Luigi/Make) are common for dependency-ordered steps but are overkill for a solo thesis; a simple Makefile or ordered CLI scripts suffice.
